notes: Technical report (arXiv 2412.03555), not a system card. Safety content is Appendix D + Table 12 only (FairFace captions via Perspective API). Child/content safety and representational-harm prompt evals are claimed with no numeric results. Skipped capability tables (AI2D, DocVQA, ChartQA, TextVQA, VQAv2, COCO, DOCCI caption metrics including NES, VSR, FinTabNet, molecule/music OCR, RadGraph, on-device latency, etc.) under pilot safety-only rule. DOCCI factual-alignment claim used for hallucination topic; NES numbers skipped as captioning capability. FairFace table does not name resolution or pt vs mix; mapped 3B/10B/28B to pt checkpoints. Mix checkpoints and extra resolutions not separately covered. alsoDocuments google-paligemma-2-blog not fetched. No risk framework levels or external testers. Table 12 names only sizes, so rows keep raw names. DOCCI NES rows (Table 6) kept as a hallucination measure.
